description: This source file contains functions for repacking kernel and ramdisk images, including building and copying images, and handling vendor and system dlkm images within the Android Open Source Project's build system.

methods.name: RebuildDlkmAndVbmeta
methods.description: Builds and updates the dlkm and vbmeta images for a given partition.

methods.name: RepackSuperAndVbmeta
methods.description: Rebuilds and repacks the super image along with vendor and system dlkm images.

methods.name: RepackKernelRamdisk
methods.description: Main function to handle repacking of kernel and ramdisk images, including optional kernel and ramdisk handling, and vendor boot image regeneration.
